entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, VeloFit agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return something. I just don't think it's going to work out, and I'm really disappointed.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, could you tell me your name and order number? And just to be clear, is the issue a technical fault with the item, or more of a preference issue?

My name is Arthur Pendelton, order number is VF88-901. It's not broken or anything... it's the Pro-Series jersey I ordered. I saved up for it, but it's just the wrong size. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've had a problem.
I see that here, Mr. Pendelton. Thank you for being such a valued VIP customer with us. I'm sorry the jersey wasn't a perfect fit. What specifically is the issue with the sizing?

It's just... it's far too tight across the chest. I followed the size chart, but I can barely zip it. I was so excited for it, but I can't ride in it like this. I was hoping to just send it back. Honestly, I could really use the money back right now.
I completely understand. It's so disappointing when something you're looking forward to doesn't fit correctly. Let me just check the policy for you. I see the jersey was delivered 13 days ago.
Yes, that's right. I hope it's not too late. I just feel bad about the whole thing.

Not at all, Mr. Pendelton. For standard items like this jersey, VeloFit has a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. We can absolutely get that started for you. Would you prefer the refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you so much, Diana. A refund would be best for now. You've made my day.

Of course. I've just emailed you a prepaid return shipping label. Just package the item and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. And for the sizing trouble, and as a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase.
Wow, you didn't have to do that! That's wonderful. Thank you, Diana. I really appreciate your help.
You're most welcome, Mr. Pendelton. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been fantastic.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
